_comment: Every host with at least one catalogue record and no official logo. reason_code is drawn from the fixed vocabulary below so the state can be read by a machine; detail is supporting evidence only and is never used to derive a decision.

_reason_codes.inline_svg_only: the identity logo is inlined in the page and no file asset exists
_reason_codes.css_sprite_only: the logo is a CSS sprite fragment and no standalone file exists
_reason_codes.white_variant_only: every published variant is white or reversed, invisible on a light card
_reason_codes.source_blocked: the awarding body refused automated access and could not be inspected
_reason_codes.domain_dead: the host no longer resolves in DNS
_reason_codes.page_dead: the official page returns 404 or a soft-404
_reason_codes.not_an_identity_logo: the only image is decorative, a banner, or a promotional lockup
_reason_codes.logo_blank_or_placeholder: the published asset renders blank or is a solid placeholder
_reason_codes.no_logo_published: the awarding body publishes no file asset for its identity mark
_reason_codes.programme_retired_no_logo_needed: the programme was retired, so no logo is published for it
